scope: Read-only complete supplied closing-claim classification, twelve-term free cash residual, total cash and operating/debt/insurance boundary reconciliation in two existing synthetic snapshots; no general sale profile or financial approval

checks.label: Caja libre de operación a apertura de venta
checks.formula: saved operating closing_free_cash_claim = supplied sale opening_free_cash
checks.scope_note: Within the explicitly supplied synthetic profile only

checks.label: Caja restringida de operación a apertura de venta
checks.formula: saved operating closing_restricted_cash_claim = supplied sale opening_restricted_cash
checks.scope_note: Within the explicitly supplied synthetic profile only

checks.label: Reserva final separada del residual libre
checks.formula: opening_restricted_cash + new_reserve - reserve_release = closing_restricted_cash_claim
checks.scope_note: Within the explicitly supplied synthetic profile only

checks.label: Obligación y pago declarados de principal
checks.formula: principal_due = principal_paid; due is not an additional cash subtraction
checks.scope_note: Equal declared due and paid does not authenticate bank payment or legal discharge; only paid enters cash residual

checks.label: Obligación y pago declarados de interest
checks.formula: interest_due = interest_paid; due is not an additional cash subtraction
checks.scope_note: Equal declared due and paid does not authenticate bank payment or legal discharge; only paid enters cash residual

checks.label: Obligación y pago declarados de fees
checks.formula: fees_due = fees_paid; due is not an additional cash subtraction
checks.scope_note: Equal declared due and paid does not authenticate bank payment or legal discharge; only paid enters cash residual

checks.label: Obligación y pago declarados de other
checks.formula: other_due = other_paid; due is not an additional cash subtraction
checks.scope_note: Equal declared due and paid does not authenticate bank payment or legal discharge; only paid enters cash residual

checks.label: Puente de saldos contables del seguro al pago de corte
checks.formula: before_payables - after_payables + after_prepaid - before_prepaid = supplied terminal insurance payment sum
checks.scope_note: Within the explicitly supplied synthetic profile only

checks.label: Seguro incluido una vez en otros usos del cierre
checks.formula: supplied terminal insurance payment sum = supplied closing other_cash_uses under the explicit only-insurance assumption
checks.scope_note: Entire other_cash_uses is this one insurance cut payment only in the supplied profile; no general decomposition or additional deduction

checks.label: Pago nominal en la fecha de corte frente al binding
checks.formula: sum(plan payments with payment_date exactly closing_date) = supplied terminal binding payment sum
checks.scope_note: All payment IDs, installment IDs, dates and amounts matched; no acceleration or authenticated payment assumed

checks.label: Doce términos al cobro neto de venta
checks.formula: sum(twelve signed free_cash_terms) = saved net_sale_distribution
checks.scope_note: Within the explicitly supplied synthetic profile only

checks.label: Conservación total sin sumar transferencias internas
checks.formula: opening_free_cash + opening_restricted_cash + gross_proceeds + other_cash_sources = debt_paid + closing_costs_paid + other_cash_uses + positive residual distribution + retained_free_cash + closing_restricted_cash_claim; no new contribution in this positive-residual profile
checks.scope_note: Reserve release/new reserve move between free/restricted accounts; opening/closing stocks enter total conservation instead. Positive residual implies zero extra equity contribution only in this profile

checks.label: Principal anterior a todos los pagos de la fecha de cierre
checks.formula: zero-rate loan principal - (principal / amortization_payments) * count(payment_dates strictly before closing_date) = principal_due before all closing-date events
checks.scope_note: Five supplied zero-rate scheduled principal payments occur strictly before cut; the sixth coincides with cut and is not separately deducted again from the stated payoff

checks.label: Principal del agregado tenencia y venta frente a sus dos fases
checks.formula: sum(supplied operating debt_principal_payment) + supplied closing principal_paid = saved holding-plus-sale debt_principal
checks.scope_note: Holding-plus-sale principal200 already includes operating100 and closing100; it is not another sale-only payoff
